metrics.label: Called pitches
metrics.desc: Called pitches (balls and called strikes) with a location.

metrics.label: Accuracy
metrics.desc: Calls matching the rulebook zone (plate half-width plus a ball radius; the batter's zone top and bottom +/- 0.12 ft).

metrics.label: Expected accuracy
metrics.desc: Accuracy the league surface (without his effect) would have had on his pitches.

metrics.label: Consistency
metrics.desc: Calls agreeing with his own fitted zone (league surface plus his effect).

metrics.label: Zone size (+strikes/100)
metrics.desc: Called strikes above the league expectation per 100 called pitches.

metrics.label: Run impact/game
metrics.desc: Absolute run-expectancy swing of missed calls per game.

metrics.label: Zone effect (log-odds)
metrics.desc: His random effect in the called-strike model (+ = more strikes).
